work_items.title: SoftAura OpenAPI contract and NestJS catalog stubs
work_items.description: Author the M1 OpenAPI 3.1 contract and NestJS backend stubs that implement getHealth (GET /health), listProducts (GET /products), and getProductById (GET /products/{productId}) with in-memory SoftAura seed shaped like Category, Product, ProductVariant responses; include Prisma-shaped stubs for deferred User, RefreshToken, Address, Cart, CartItem, Order, OrderItem, Payment. Flutter M1 still uses local mock DTOs matching this surface; full Prisma/PostgreSQL deferred so the emulator demo is not blocked.
work_items.estimate_rationale: Three stub ops plus OpenAPI and model stubs; no full Prisma/Postgres runtime required for M1. | backend_developer: OpenAPI 3.1 for three ops plus eleven model schemas, Nest health/catalog stubs with 24-SKU in-memory seed (pagination/search/category filter), Prisma-shaped deferred models, and Jest/Supertest to green is roughly a full focused day—not a half-day stub.; concerns: listProducts filters and pagination make this more than bare stubs; health-vs-no-Postgres for M1 is ambiguous; Flutter assets/data/catalog.json and generated client must stay byte-compatible with the OpenAPI Product/Category/ProductVariant shapes or M1 demo drifts.

work_items.title: Flutter scaffold SoftAura theme and go_router
work_items.description: Create Flutter 3.x Android-first app with Riverpod, SoftAura tokens in lib/core/theme (sage #7A9E8E, warm ivory, charcoal, rounded imagery), and go_router routes /products, /products/:id, /cart. Offline mock only in debug; no live HTTP. App launches on emulator as coding start.
work_items.estimate_rationale: Standard Flutter scaffold plus theme tokens and three named routes. | frontend_developer: Flutter 3.x Android-first bootstrap with Riverpod, SoftAura token theme, three go_router routes, debug-only offline mock wiring, and emulator launch verification including cleartext prep for 10.0.2.2.; concerns: First green emulator run and dep/toolchain friction on Windows can eat half a day even when the code itself is small; WI-001 theme/OpenAPI inputs must be stable before tokens and route names are locked.

work_items.title: Local catalog seed and ProductListScreen
work_items.description: Add assets/data/catalog.json with 24 SKUs across Body Wash, Cleansers, Moisturizers, Face Care (including ~1299 cents USD body-wash style), LocalCatalogDataSource and CatalogRepository mirroring listProducts responses, ProductListNotifier, and SCR-01 ProductListScreen with name, cents→USD price helper (no floats), rounded imagery, category, loading/empty/error. flutter_test for price formatting and list smoke.
work_items.estimate_rationale: 24-SKU seed, repository/notifier, list UI states, and cents price formatting tests. | frontend_developer: 24-SKU catalog.json, models shaped like listProducts, LocalCatalogDataSource/CatalogRepository, ProductListNotifier, SCR-01 with loading/empty/error, integer-cents USD helper, and flutter_test coverage for price formatting plus list smoke.; concerns: Seed and domain models must mirror the OpenAPI Product/Category/ProductVariant shapes closely enough that M2 can swap to generated CatalogApi without rewriting the UI layer.

work_items.title: ProductDetailScreen and list-detail navigation
work_items.description: Build SCR-02 ProductDetailScreen (/products/:id) with ProductDetailNotifier loading one product shaped like getProductById: name, brand, category, unit price from integer cents + USD, description, rounded image, SoftAura styling. Tap from SCR-01 navigates; Android back returns to list with catalog still visible. flutter_test for list→detail navigation.
work_items.estimate_rationale: Single detail screen plus go_router param and navigation test on existing catalog models. | frontend_developer: SCR-02 ProductDetailNotifier and detail UI for getProductById-shaped data, go_router /products/:id param, SoftAura styling, and a flutter_test for list→detail with Android-back preserving list state.; concerns: go_router widget-test harness and AsyncNotifier pump timing are the main effort drivers; catalog must stay in memory across pop so list does not reload empty.

work_items.title: In-memory CartNotifier and CartScreen
work_items.description: Optional M1 cart: CartNotifier session-only CartState; Add to cart on SCR-02 (≥48dp) snapshots product name and unit price (cents + currency) into Cart/CartItem; SCR-03 CartScreen (/cart) shows line items; contents survive list/detail navigation until process kill. No persistence, auth, payment, or backend sync.
work_items.estimate_rationale: In-memory notifier plus one cart screen and snapshot-on-add from detail. | frontend_developer: Session-only CartNotifier/CartState, ≥48dp Add to cart on SCR-02 snapshotting name and cents+currency into CartItem, SCR-03 line-item CartScreen, and tests that cart survives list/detail navigation until process kill.; concerns: No persistence/auth/payment is intentional for M1—avoid sneaking in secure storage or API sync; Cart/CartItem shapes should stay snapshot-friendly for a later server cart without blocking this item.

milestones.name: SoftAura Flutter speed demo
milestones.goal: Runnable SoftAura Flutter MVP on Android emulator: browse 24 local mock SKUs, open product detail with cents-based USD prices and SoftAura styling, optional in-memory cart; NestJS stubs implement getHealth/listProducts/getProductById for the frozen OpenAPI contract—no auth, payments, or live backend required for the demo path.
